requirements.quote:
The record layer fragments information blocks into TLSPlaintext
   records carrying data in chunks of 2^14 bytes or less.
requirements.condition: the record layer fragments higher-level information into TLSPlaintext records
requirements.required_behavior: limit each record's data chunk to at most 16384 bytes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: creating a TLSPlaintext data chunk larger than 16384 bytes
requirements.why_checkable: Serialized fragment sizes have an exact upper bound.

requirements.quote:
Handshake messages MUST NOT be interleaved with other record
      types.  That is, if a handshake message is split over two or more
      records, there MUST NOT be any other records between them.
requirements.condition: a handshake message is fragmented across multiple records
requirements.required_behavior: place its record fragments consecutively
requirements.forbidden_behavior: interleaving any other record between fragments of the handshake message
requirements.why_checkable: Record ordering can be checked while reassembling one handshake message.

requirements.quote: Handshake messages MUST NOT span key changes.
requirements.required_behavior: complete all fragments within one record-protection key generation
requirements.forbidden_behavior: placing a key change between fragments of one handshake message
requirements.why_checkable: Fragment reassembly state can be correlated with traffic-key transitions.

requirements.quote:
Implementations
      MUST verify that all messages immediately preceding a key change
      align with a record boundary
requirements.condition: processing a message that immediately precedes a key change
requirements.required_behavior: verify that the message ends at a record boundary
requirements.forbidden_behavior: changing keys with a partially consumed handshake message in the record
requirements.why_checkable: The parser knows both message and record endpoints at each key transition.

requirements.quote:
if not, then they MUST terminate the
      connection with an "unexpected_message" alert.
requirements.condition: a message immediately preceding a key change does not align with a record boundary
requirements.required_behavior: terminate the connection
requirements.forbidden_behavior: performing the key change or continuing record processing
requirements.why_checkable: A deliberately misaligned message has an exact terminal alert.

requirements.quote:
Because the
      ClientHello, EndOfEarlyData, ServerHello, Finished, and KeyUpdate
      messages can immediately precede a key change, implementations
      MUST send these messages in alignment with a record boundary.
requirements.required_behavior: end ClientHello at a record boundary
requirements.forbidden_behavior: placing bytes of a following message in the same partial boundary context
requirements.why_checkable: ClientHello's final byte can be compared with the containing record's final byte.

requirements.quote:
Because the
      ClientHello, EndOfEarlyData, ServerHello, Finished, and KeyUpdate
      messages can immediately precede a key change, implementations
      MUST send these messages in alignment with a record boundary.
requirements.required_behavior: end EndOfEarlyData at a record boundary
requirements.forbidden_behavior: coalescing following handshake bytes into the same record
requirements.why_checkable: EndOfEarlyData's endpoint can be compared with the record endpoint.

requirements.quote:
Because the
      ClientHello, EndOfEarlyData, ServerHello, Finished, and KeyUpdate
      messages can immediately precede a key change, implementations
      MUST send these messages in alignment with a record boundary.
requirements.required_behavior: end ServerHello at a record boundary
requirements.forbidden_behavior: coalescing following handshake bytes into the same record
requirements.why_checkable: ServerHello's endpoint can be compared with the record endpoint.

requirements.quote:
Because the
      ClientHello, EndOfEarlyData, ServerHello, Finished, and KeyUpdate
      messages can immediately precede a key change, implementations
      MUST send these messages in alignment with a record boundary.
requirements.required_behavior: end Finished at a record boundary
requirements.forbidden_behavior: coalescing following handshake bytes into the same record
requirements.why_checkable: Finished's endpoint can be compared with the record endpoint.

requirements.quote:
Because the
      ClientHello, EndOfEarlyData, ServerHello, Finished, and KeyUpdate
      messages can immediately precede a key change, implementations
      MUST send these messages in alignment with a record boundary.
requirements.required_behavior: end KeyUpdate at a record boundary
requirements.forbidden_behavior: coalescing following handshake bytes into the same record
requirements.why_checkable: KeyUpdate's endpoint can be compared with the record endpoint.

requirements.quote:
Implementations MUST NOT send zero-length fragments of Handshake
   types, even if those fragments contain padding.
requirements.condition: sending a record whose inner content type is Handshake
requirements.forbidden_behavior: sending a zero-length Handshake content fragment, including a padding-only record
requirements.why_checkable: The unpadded Handshake content length is directly measurable.

requirements.quote: Alert messages (Section 6) MUST NOT be fragmented across records
requirements.required_behavior: place the entire Alert message in one record
requirements.forbidden_behavior: fragmenting one Alert message across records
requirements.why_checkable: Alert framing can be checked against record boundaries.

requirements.quote:
multiple alert messages MUST NOT be coalesced into a single
   TLSPlaintext record.
requirements.required_behavior: place each Alert message in a separate TLSPlaintext record
requirements.forbidden_behavior: coalescing multiple Alert messages into one record
requirements.why_checkable: The number of Alert messages per record is directly parseable.

requirements.quote:
a record with an Alert type
   MUST contain exactly one message.
requirements.condition: a TLSPlaintext record has Alert content type
requirements.required_behavior: contain exactly one complete Alert message
requirements.forbidden_behavior: containing zero, multiple, or partial Alert messages
requirements.why_checkable: The record payload can be parsed and counted against an exact cardinality.

requirements.quote: Application Data messages are always protected.
requirements.required_behavior: apply record protection before transmission
requirements.forbidden_behavior: sending Application Data as TLSPlaintext on the wire
requirements.why_checkable: The outer record form and active protection state are observable.

requirements.quote: invalid(0)
requirements.required_behavior: map invalid to numeric value 0
requirements.forbidden_behavior: mapping invalid to another value
requirements.why_checkable: The enum's numeric encoding is explicit.

requirements.quote: change_cipher_spec(20)
requirements.required_behavior: map change_cipher_spec to numeric value 20
requirements.forbidden_behavior: using another numeric value for change_cipher_spec
requirements.why_checkable: The enum's numeric encoding is explicit.

requirements.quote: alert(21)
requirements.required_behavior: map alert to numeric value 21
requirements.forbidden_behavior: using another numeric value for alert
requirements.why_checkable: The enum's numeric encoding is explicit.

requirements.quote: handshake(22)
requirements.required_behavior: map handshake to numeric value 22
requirements.forbidden_behavior: using another numeric value for handshake
requirements.why_checkable: The enum's numeric encoding is explicit.

requirements.quote: application_data(23)
requirements.required_behavior: map application_data to numeric value 23
requirements.forbidden_behavior: using another numeric value for application_data
requirements.why_checkable: The enum's numeric encoding is explicit.

requirements.condition: serializing or parsing the ContentType enum
requirements.required_behavior: use a one-octet enum representation with a maximum representable value of 255
requirements.forbidden_behavior: using a wider or narrower wire representation
requirements.why_checkable: TLS enum sizing is fixed by the explicit maximum value.

requirements.quote: ContentType type;
requirements.required_behavior: encode type as the first field with ContentType encoding
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omitting or reordering the type field
requirements.why_checkable: The field type and first position are explicit.

requirements.quote: ProtocolVersion legacy_record_version;
requirements.required_behavior: encode legacy_record_version as ProtocolVersion after type
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omitting, reordering, or using another field width
requirements.why_checkable: The field type and ordered position are explicit.

requirements.quote: uint16 length;
requirements.required_behavior: encode length as uint16 after legacy_record_version
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omitting, reordering, or using another field width
requirements.why_checkable: The field width and ordered position are explicit.

requirements.quote: opaque fragment[TLSPlaintext.length];
requirements.required_behavior: encode fragment as exactly TLSPlaintext.length opaque bytes after length
requirements.forbidden_behavior: a fragment whose encoded byte count differs from length or is out of order
requirements.why_checkable: The field's position and exact dependent length are explicit.

requirements.quote:
type:  The higher-level protocol used to process the enclosed
      fragment.
requirements.required_behavior: select the higher-level protocol according to the type field
requirements.forbidden_behavior: dispatching the fragment independently of its type
requirements.why_checkable: Parser dispatch can be traced from the concrete ContentType value.

requirements.quote:
legacy_record_version:  MUST be set to 0x0303 for all records
      generated by a TLS 1.3 implementation other than an initial
      ClientHello
requirements.condition: a TLS 1.3 implementation generates a record other than the initial ClientHello record
requirements.required_behavior: set legacy_record_version to 0x0303
requirements.forbidden_behavior: using another legacy_record_version
requirements.why_checkable: The two-byte record-header field has a fixed value.

requirements.quote:
an initial
      ClientHello (i.e., one not generated after a HelloRetryRequest),
      where it MAY also be 0x0301 for compatibility purposes.
requirements.condition: a TLS 1.3 implementation generates the initial ClientHello record
requirements.required_behavior: use 0x0303 or the compatibility value 0x0301 for legacy_record_version
requirements.forbidden_behavior: using any other version value
requirements.why_checkable: The initial record header has a finite permitted value set.

requirements.quote:
This
      field is deprecated and MUST be ignored for all purposes.
requirements.required_behavior: ignore the field for protocol-version negotiation and all other processing decisions
requirements.forbidden_behavior: changing TLS 1.3 processing based on the received field
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can vary the received field and compare parser state and negotiation behavior.

requirements.quote:
length:  The length (in bytes) of the following
      TLSPlaintext.fragment.
requirements.required_behavior: make length equal the byte count of the following fragment
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accepting or emitting a length inconsistent with the fragment
requirements.why_checkable: The declared length can be compared with available fragment bytes.

requirements.quote: The length MUST NOT exceed 2^14 bytes.
requirements.condition: encoding or accepting a TLSPlaintext record
requirements.required_behavior: limit TLSPlaintext.length to at most 16384
requirements.forbidden_behavior: a TLSPlaintext.length greater than 16384
requirements.why_checkable: The length field has an exact numeric upper bound.

requirements.quote:
An
      endpoint that receives a record that exceeds this length MUST
      terminate the connection with a "record_overflow" alert.
requirements.condition: an endpoint receives TLSPlaintext.length greater than 16384
requirements.required_behavior: terminate the connection
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accepting, truncating, or continuing after the oversized record
requirements.why_checkable: An oversized record has a fixed terminal alert.

requirements.quote:
a record containing an initial ClientHello SHOULD have
   version 0x0301 (reflecting TLS 1.0)
requirements.condition: generating a record containing the initial ClientHello
requirements.required_behavior: set legacy_record_version to 0x0301
requirements.why_checkable: The initial ClientHello record header is directly inspectable.

requirements.quote:
a record containing a second
   ClientHello or a ServerHello MUST have version 0x0303
requirements.condition: generating a record containing a second ClientHello after HelloRetryRequest
requirements.required_behavior: set legacy_record_version to 0x0303
requirements.forbidden_behavior: using any other version value
requirements.why_checkable: The second ClientHello record header has a fixed two-byte value.

requirements.quote:
a record containing a second
   ClientHello or a ServerHello MUST have version 0x0303
requirements.required_behavior: set legacy_record_version to 0x0303
requirements.forbidden_behavior: using any other version value
requirements.why_checkable: The ServerHello record header has a fixed two-byte value.

requirements.quote:
When record protection has not yet been engaged, TLSPlaintext
   structures are written directly onto the wire.
requirements.condition: record protection has not yet been engaged
requirements.required_behavior: write TLSPlaintext structures directly on the wire
requirements.forbidden_behavior: wrapping them as TLSCiphertext before protection begins
requirements.why_checkable: The record form is determined by the protection-state flag.

requirements.quote:
Once record
   protection has started, TLSPlaintext records are protected and sent
   as described in the following section.
requirements.required_behavior: protect TLSPlaintext and transmit it in TLSCiphertext form
requirements.forbidden_behavior: writing TLSPlaintext directly on the wire
requirements.why_checkable: The active traffic-key state determines the observable record form.

requirements.quote:
Application Data
   records MUST NOT be written to the wire unprotected
requirements.required_behavior: protect the record before writing it to the wire
requirements.forbidden_behavior: writing unprotected Application Data
requirements.why_checkable: Application Data record protection is directly observable.
